Thanks Ben — got the invite but ran into a join problem when I tried the link. Zoom shows me as "waiting for host" and my IT contact Tim says our org requires authenticated domains for external meetings; the dial-in page also asks to sign in. We can't guarantee someone will be able to host from our side if the meeting requires Redwood account auth.

Could you either use a meeting link that allows guest participants without authentication or share a Google Meet link? Also, I see two calendar events in my calendar for the same time (one marked "Invited by ben.carter@redwood.ai" and another with no organizer) — looks like a duplicate got created.

Appreciate if we can consolidate and resend — Tim included.

Best,
Susan
